'''Tomokazu Seki''' (Japanese: '''関智一''' ''Seki Tomokazu'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Seki was born on September 8, 1972 in {{wp|Kōtō}}, {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor and singer as an adult. His first role in his career was in the 1993 anime ''{{wp|Mobile Suit Victory Gundam}}''; he has since gone on to voice a number of well-known roles in anime series. Seki joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|OS}}, with his most prominent role being that of [[Tracey Sketchit]], one of {{Ash}}'s {{ashfr|traveling companions}}. He once worked with the {{wp|Tokyo Actor's Consumer's Cooperative Society}}, but is now affiliated with Atomic Monkey.
